Configuration.Name: XLD_nutr_norm_relPP
Configuration.Description: relative nutrient flux workaround derived from 'mixing' layer depth to help drive relative PP. See text for details.

Configuration.Name: Temp avg 0-10 ALT CLIM
Configuration.Description: temperature from 0 to 10 metres from the HOTSSEA v1 model. 'alt clim' refers to an alternative climatology used for the spin up period. See manuscript for details. YYYY-DD where DD is day of year in 3-day blocks

Configuration.Name: Salinity avg 0 to 10 m
Configuration.Description: salinity from 0 to 10 metres from the HOTSSEA v1 model. file naming YYYY-DD where DD is day of year in 3 day blocks the 1978 - 1979 years are used only for spin-up and contain climatologies. See manuscript for details.

Configuration.Name: PAR
Configuration.Description: photosynthetically active irradiance (PAR). 'alt clim' files refer to an adjustment made in SC300 to climatologies calculated using incoming light from RDRS v2.1 and HOTSSEA outputs. file name YYYY_DD where DD is day of year in 3-day blocks. See manuscript for details.
